entry.title: BUGATTI – A NEW ERA: Extreme Conditions pt. 2​

media:group.media:title: BUGATTI – A NEW ERA: Extreme Conditions pt. 2​
media:group.media:description:
An uncompromising commitment: perfecting the driving experience.​ ​ From the frozen expanses of northern Sweden to the searing heat of southern Spain, the BUGATTI TOURBILLON is tested around the world in the most unforgiving conditions. ​
In Episode 19 of the documentary series “A New Era,” BUGATTI heads to the racetrack in Seville to put the TOURBILLON through its paces in the heat of southern Spain. In a place where temperatures can rise well above 40 °C (104 °F), the TOURBILLON prototypes are subjected to a completely different kind of stress.​
#BUGATTI #TOURBILLON​ –​ WLTP: bugatti.link/consumption​

entry.title: BUGATTI celebrates its Service Partners from Greenwich and their 20 years of expertise

media:group.media:title: BUGATTI celebrates its Service Partners from Greenwich and their 20 years of expertise
media:group.media:description:
Paul Matula, Service Manager, and Todd Testerman, Master Service Technician at BUGATTI Greenwich, have each spent two decades supporting BUGATTI and its customers. Their experience spans multiple chapters of the brand’s modern history, accompanying the brand's hyper sports cars through successive eras while building an exceptional depth of technical knowledge and a relationship with the marque that has grown alongside it.
Their stories reflect the value BUGATTI places on its teams’ and partners’ devotion and expertise built over time.
#BUGATTI

entry.title: BUGATTI – A NEW ERA: Sound of a New Era Pt.1

media:group.media:title: BUGATTI – A NEW ERA: Sound of a New Era Pt.1
media:group.media:description:
For more than two decades, the sound of the W16 engine has defined the brand’s identity; now, the sound of the new naturally aspirated V16 engine is set to usher in a new era for BUGATTI.
In the latest episode of the ‘A New Era’ docuseries, BUGATTI engineers reveal how this sound was developed, refined and ultimately confirmed, marking the completion of one of the TOURBILLON’s defining elements.
The result is a sound designed to heighten the emotional connection between machine and driver. Raw yet refined when demanded, and entirely mechanical in its origin, the TOURBILLON’s engine note carries the spirit of BUGATTI’s past into a new era.
#BUGATTI #TOURBILLON – WLTP: bugatti.link/consumption

entry.title: THE BUGATTI DESTRIER: A MASTERPIECE OF PURE ELEGANCE ON CALIFORNIA'S COASTLINE

media:group.media:title: THE BUGATTI DESTRIER: A MASTERPIECE OF PURE ELEGANCE ON CALIFORNIA'S COASTLINE
media:group.media:description:
Some roads lead to destinations. Others become part of the story. Above the Pacific, where nature's grandeur unfolds at every turn, the BUGATTI DESTRIER continues a journey unlike any other. The third one-of-one creation from the BUGATTI Programme Solitaire, it reimagines the extraordinary Bolide through a lens of elegance, transforming extreme performance into an enduring expression of beauty. With breathtaking proportions and a design rooted in grace, dignity, and timeless style, DESTRIER is a celebration of individuality and craftsmanship at its highest level.
#BUGATTI #DESTRIER – WLTP: bugatti.link/consumption
